"""Print Foxhill Wool's season sheet.

The haulier's exports land in shearings/, one row per pickup:

    pickup_id,pickup_date,shed,kg

The season sheet prints one line per pickup date, in date order,
followed by a totals line:

    <pickup_date>,<pickups>,<kg>
    TOTAL,<pickups>,<kg>

Pickups are counted per pickup_id: the haulier's tablet re-sends a
pickup when the shed's scale link is slow, and the repeated rows are
identical copies of the same pickup.
"""

files.README.md:
# Foxhill Wool - season sheet

shedbook.py prints the season sheet from the haulier's exports in
shearings/. The haulier's tablet re-sends a pickup when the shed's
scale link is slow: repeated rows are identical copies of the same
pickup_id, and the sheet counts each pickup once. The exports are
the haulier's own record.
